review.tagline: Chinese-language library of 277 role-based agent prompts for coding tools
review.summary: Markdown agent definitions across 20 departments (executive, engineering, design, marketing, and others), each with a persona, workflow and deliverables. It is a Chinese community edition of msitarzewski/agency-agents: 213 translated roles plus China-market originals such as Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat, Feishu and DingTalk. Shell scripts convert and install the files into 20 tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI.
review.audience: Chinese-speaking developers adding role agents to AI coding tools
strengths: Install script targets 20 tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex CLI, Aider and Gemini CLI
Roles define persona, workflow and deliverables, not one-line prompts
Covers China-specific platforms and domains (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk)
MIT license; files can be copied by hand into ~/.claude/agents/
weaknesses: Role content and docs are in Chinese; English is only linked to the upstream repo
Only Claude Code and Copilot install directly; other tools need convert.sh first
README counts disagree (277 total, 268 in gallery, 63 vs 64 originals)
README is dominated by sponsor and course promotion; quality of roles is unverified here
needs: Models: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI
